Dev server stopped, temp scripts removed.

## Files changed

**Added**
- `src/gallery/StageCarousel.tsx` — the carousel: `CarouselPeek` (neighbouring works, real assets, `aria-hidden`, `alt=""`, animated with the track), `CarouselProgress` (six bars, Motion `layoutId` fill, `aria-hidden`, no autoplay), and the `AnimatePresence` stage that both manual arrows and WebMCP navigation already feed.

**Rewritten**
- `src/gallery/SpeakingStyleSelect.tsx` — native `<select>` replaced by an ARIA **radiogroup** named "Speaking style" with five radios (Literal…Curatorial). Roving `tabIndex` (one keyboard stop), selection follows focus, Arrow Left/Right/Up/Down wrap, Home/End, digits 1–5, Space/Enter. Digits shown but `aria-hidden` so each option is named by its style alone; each radio is `aria-describedby` its mode description; the group carries a concise instruction. The selected pill is a single Motion `layoutId` element that travels between options (unique id per instance, so both copies animate independently); settings variant crossfades the description with `AnimatePresence mode="wait"`.

**Modified**
- `src/App.tsx` — stage block replaced by `<StageCarousel>`; direction logic, History, atmosphere, cog, and status untouched.
- `src/gallery/ArtworkStage.tsx` — enter/exit now travel 140 px with `scale 0.94` and `blur(9px) → blur(0)`, so the chosen neighbour resolves into the crisp centre; frame, painting, and wall label still move as one figure.
- `src/gallery/SettingsDialog.tsx` — focus-trap selector excludes `[tabindex="-1"]`, so the roving radios don't distort the trap.
- `src/app.css` — new `carousel` layer (peeks: blur/dim/edge-gradient masks, full-bleed cropping stage, progress bars) and a rewritten `style-select` layer (track, pill, option, index). Retuned `--caption-reserve`, `--style-reserve`, new `--progress-reserve`/`--peek-space`, hall padding — measured, not guessed, so the painting keeps its dominance with the progress row added. Forced-colors and reduced-motion blocks updated.
- Tests: `tests/App.test.tsx`, `tests/accessibility.test.tsx`, `tests/tool-contracts.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/manual-gallery.spec.ts`, `tests/e2e/motion.spec.ts`, `tests/e2e/tool-gallery.spec.ts`.

## Tests and results

`npm run check`: typecheck clean · **57/57 vitest** (was 48) · build OK · **19/19 Playwright** (was 14). E2E re-run 3×, stable. `npm audit --audit-level=high`: **0 vulnerabilities**.

New coverage: no `SELECT` anywhere (page and dialog); radiogroup semantics, names, per-option descriptions, `aria-checked`, roving tabIndex invariant; both arrow axes with wrapping, Home/End, 1–5, Space/Enter, ignored digits and modified presses; wall-label ⇄ settings sync including the WebMCP path (settings copy checked after `set_experience_mode`); pill layout animation proven by counting Motion's per-frame projection writes and by catching a non-identity transform mid-flight, versus instant placement under reduced motion; peeks present, using the actual neighbour `src`, blurred + masked + dimmed, `aria-hidden`, contributing no second `img` or heading, following the new neighbours after navigation; six bars tracking all six works forward and back with no autoplay (2 s idle changes nothing); axe clean in both states. Existing modal/History/Site-Tools/zoom/image-error/focus-return assertions all still pass.

## Screenshots — `/tmp/aiccessibility-shots/`

`desktop.png`, `carousel-mid.png`, `carousel-rest.png`, `speaking-selector.png`, `speaking-selector-inflight.png` (pill caught between options), `settings-desktop.png`, `mobile.png`, `mobile-carousel-mid.png`, `settings-mobile.png`, `zoom-200.png` (640×640), `reduced-motion.png`, `reduced-motion-mid.png`. Three visual defects found and fixed while iterating: peek slivers first read as floating smudges (fixed by full-bleeding the stage so they crop at the room's edge), Motion's inline `opacity` overrode the peek dimming (moved to the container), and the pill sat behind the track background (`z-index: -1` removed, text spans positioned instead).

## Remaining risks

1. **Vertical budget is tighter.** At 1280×720 the painting is 406 px against the smoke test's 396 px floor, with ~11 px of layout slack. Any label-font or reserve change should be re-measured; `--caption-reserve`, `--style-reserve`, `--progress-reserve` are the knobs.
2. **Peek height is proportional (`62cqh`), not matched per neighbour**, so a very tall or very wide neighbour crops differently. Deliberate — it keeps the slivers uniform — but it is an approximation.
3. **Six full-size neighbour images now load** (two extra at first paint). It warms the cache for navigation, but it is real bandwidth on a slow connection.
4. **`mask-composite: intersect`** carries a `-webkit-mask-composite` fallback; on an engine supporting neither, the slivers lose their fade and show a hard edge (nothing else breaks).
5. **Two figures share the stage for ~520 ms** during a transition; unscoped `.artwork-figure` locators will hit strict-mode violations.
6. **ChatGPT/Voice live validation remains unvalidated** — unchanged and not claimed anywhere. `docs/voice-validation.md`, `docs/hackathon-build/*`, and `.devpost-hackathon-state.json` were not touched; nothing committed, pushed, or deployed.
